chunks: From him, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad, from his uncle, from al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
O the One Who pointed me to Himself and humbled my heart by my affirming Him, I ask You for security and faith in this world and the Hereafter.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (the Satisfied One), a title of Imam Ali ibn Musa (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for security and faith in this world and the Hereafter according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: This supplication, narrated from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), emphasizes the foundational role of divine self-revelation (tawhid) in cultivating inner security (al-amn) and steadfast faith (al-iman). It reflects the Shia theological emphasis on linking worldly tranquility to spiritual certainty, serving as a concise model for integrating belief with daily spiritual needs.
